build_detection_dataset: build a DetectionCOCODataset instance with config, dataset_type, and imdb_file_index for COCO object detection
create_coco_sample: create a Sample with image, targets_enc, and orig_size by indexing into DetectionCOCODataset
format_detection_predictions: format detection model outputs into COCO-style predictions with scores, labels, and bounding boxes
deduplicate_predictions: deduplicate distributed predictions by image_id using on_prediction_end to remove DistributedSampler duplicates
postprocess_detection_outputs: postprocess model logits and bounding boxes into scores, labels, and absolute coordinate boxes using PostProcess
